sources.title: 江苏省人民政府2012第三批珍贵古籍名录02273：扬州市图书馆徐安1599《古今律历考》有补配
sources.provider: 江苏省人民政府政府公报
sources.quality_notes: Official 2012-06-29 Su Zheng Fa No.86 government gazette (issue 23), publicly navigated from the official 2012-year issue index, directly prints item02273 古今律历考七十二卷 明万历二十七年(1599)徐安刻本(有补配) 扬州市图书馆. Corrects earlier SECONDARY-ONLY bound, while older exact .doc HTTP403 remains route-specific. The 1599 date is the catalog edition label; supplemented leaf inventory, juan45 survival, target glyph, copy-date/impression and printing-plate independence remain wholly unverified.
